annotations.title: List the saved versions of a studio edit

description:
[read-only] Saved versions (drafts and final cuts) of a Long-form Studio project (`id`), newest first, and THE final cut: the one campaigns and approvals use, with its rendered draft (`contentId`). Pass `diff` (a cut id, or empty for the board as it stands) to also get what it changed since the auto cut. Free.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/video-studio/projects/{id}/cuts.)
name: list_studio_cuts
title: List the saved versions of a studio edit
